_readme: SAMPLE DATA — fictional Continuity state for Sam Rivers. This file is optional; omit it if your Datascape data source does not yet produce temporal decision state.

snapshots.label: 5 days ago
snapshots.largeContext: QuietInbox is still blocked by product reliability.

Product readiness.summary: The digest flow is not yet reliable enough to justify acquisition work.
evidence: Generation timeout still reproduces intermittently.
Preference reload has not completed a full regression pass.

Distribution.summary: Acquisition ideas exist, but product reliability still dominates the next commitment.
evidence: No acquisition channel has enough evidence to outrank reliability work.

snapshots.label: 2 days ago
snapshots.largeContext: QuietInbox reliability is acceptable; distribution becomes the main uncertainty.

Product readiness.summary: Core generation and persistence flows are reliable enough for external testing.
evidence: Generation regression suite passed.
Saved preference reload passed.
No blocking production error observed in the validation window.

Distribution.summary: The project has crossed from build-first into evidence-first acquisition work.
evidence: Product reliability no longer blocks an acquisition experiment.

snapshots.label: Yesterday
snapshots.largeContext: Distribution is primary; short-form content is becoming the leading hypothesis.

Distribution.summary: The system is comparing short-form, community, and direct acquisition paths.
evidence: Short-form produced the strongest initial click signal.
Community traffic appears smaller but more intentional.

Short-form experiment.summary: The first demo clip produced promising acquisition signal, but durability is unknown.
evidence: Profile-click rate exceeded the other tested channel.
Return behavior is still immature.

snapshots.label: Now
snapshots.largeContext: Distribution remains the main uncertainty; short-form leads provisionally.

Distribution.summary: A repeatable acquisition path is still unproven; short-form currently leads.
evidence: Short-form currently has the strongest acquisition signal.
Community users show stronger intent but lower reach.
Launch-platform exposure was deferred until the acquisition story is clearer.

Short-form experiment.summary: Initial acquisition is positive; retention and the repeatable creative pattern remain unresolved.
evidence: Demo comprehension improved after the latest edit.
Click-to-signup intent strengthened.
24-hour return evidence is still incomplete.

Algorithmic distribution.summary: The system is testing which early signals best explain initial reach.
evidence: Two cohorts show similar early lift.
Watch depth tracks signup intent better than raw views.
Novelty remains a plausible competing explanation.

Retention signal.summary: Acquisition looks promising, but there is not enough evidence yet to call the intent durable.
evidence: The current cohort is too young for a durable-retention commitment.

Product readiness.summary: Core generation and persistence flows remain stable enough for acquisition experiments.
evidence: No blocker has reappeared since validation.
